sources.entry: Cognition Labs - (USA) Creators of Devin, the first AI software engineer agent, designed to autonomously handle complex coding tasks from start to finish.

summary.name: Cognition
summary.one_liner: Cognition is the applied AI lab behind Devin, an autonomous AI software engineer agent that plans, writes, tests, and ships code.
use_cases: delegating complex coding tasks to an autonomous agent
writing and shipping production code inside an existing codebase
evaluating whether AI-written code would be merged
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Cognition as an applied AI lab that operates Devin, which it calls the first autonomous software engineer. Devin is said to plan, write, test, and ship production code on its own, working inside a team's codebase and existing tools. The company also announces FrontierCode, a benchmark that scores whether a model's code would be merged by a human maintainer, checking correctness, test quality, scope, style, and codebase standards. The page lists a FrontierCode 2.0 leaderboard, product updates such as Devin Security, Devin Desktop and CLI, Devin 2.2, and SWE-series models, plus Windsurf-related posts. Much of the page is company positioning and announcements rather than technical detail.
notable: Devin is described as an autonomous agent that handles coding tasks end to end inside a team's codebase
FrontierCode benchmark measures mergeability by a human maintainer rather than only unit-test passing
Publishes a FrontierCode 2.0 leaderboard comparing models
Product line includes Devin Security, Devin Desktop, Devin CLI, and SWE-series models
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Claims about deployment at large institutions and productivity are company statements not independently verified on the page
